steps.detail: Multiply by the exponent and evaluate the limit:\[ L = \lim_{x \to \infty} g(x)(f(x) - 1) = \lim_{x \to \infty} \left(1 \cdot - 3 x \left(\ln{\left(x \right)} - \ln{\left(x + 3 \right)}\right) - 1\right) = 8 \]
